request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added the viewer role, and all 4 tests in `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts` pass with `bin/e2e`.

**What changed**
- **New role:** you can now assign `viewer` from the roles form. If you type anything other than clerk, steward or viewer, the error message now names all three.
- **Server-side block:** I added a check that runs as the first step of every endpoint that changes data — 21 in all, including today, settings, roles, rates, people, hold, retire, statement, patrons, claims, claim actions, proofs, deferral, reassign, paste, quick-add and periods. If the user is a viewer on that sheet, the request is refused with a 400 before anything else runs. So nothing is stored, nothing goes to the audit file, and the screen shows that form's usual error. The new code is `setting/CheckNotViewer.java`, `ViewerRefusedException` and `HandleViewerRefused` with its escalation YAML. Loading a sheet and all read endpoints are not blocked.
- **Bulk and generate buttons:** I didn't need to change these. The page runs them one item at a time through the same single-item endpoints, so for a viewer every item is refused and the counts show 0 done, all refused, with no error.
- **Permission matrix:** it still accepts only clerk or steward. Naming a viewer there would mean nothing, because the new check refuses viewers first anyway.

Not covered: the role is decided only by the `user` name the page sends with each request, as it was before, so it doesn't stop a client that sends a different name.
